title: HMD Vibe2 Pro debuts with a 64MP rear camera, 6.78-inch display
description: HMD has debuted its latest Vibe series smartphone in India. The new Vibe2 Pro comes with features such as a 6,000mAh battery and a 64MP main rear camera. description: Lava introduced the Virat V1 Pro in late August – an affordable 5G phone with a 6.75” 720p+ 120Hz display and a 6,000mAh battery. description: Samsung launched the Galaxy A08 4G about a couple of weeks ago, and the device is on its way to India too, among many other markets.
